name: @quatico-solutions/agent-skills
description: Quatico agent skills — the quatico-skills plugin for Claude Code and Cursor
author: Quatico Solutions AG

scripts.changeset: cp .changeset/_template ".changeset/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md" && echo 'Created changeset — edit it now'
scripts.release: test -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" || GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null)" || true; test -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" || { echo "release: GITHUB_TOKEN is unset and 'gh auth token' failed. changeset version needs it to build changelog links, and it fails AFTER the skill versions are bumped — leaving a half-applied release. Export GITHUB_TOKEN or run 'gh auth login', then retry." >&2; exit 1; }; GITHUB_TOKEN="$GITHUB_TOKEN" pnpm run version && git add -u && git add .changeset package.json CHANGELOG.md .claude-plugin .cursor-plugin skills && git commit -m "chore: release v$(jq -r .version package.json)" && git tag -a "v$(jq -r .version package.json)" -m "Release v$(jq -r .version package.json)" && echo "Release committed and tagged. Run: git push --follow-tags"
